issues.issue: Whether the claimant's account of police involvement and threats is credible
issues.applicant_position: Claimant says police warned him that a man was a Mara 18 member, and he then received threats.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not mention the police visit in his original PIF; court concludes he never went to police.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant's fear is linked to a Convention ground (section 96)
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears La Mara 18 and is imputed a political opinion as a traitor for tipping off police.
issues.result_text: Claimant is a victim of crime without a link to a Convention ground; the section 96 claim fails.

issues.issue: Whether the claimant faces a personal risk under section 97 not faced generally by others
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears being killed by Mara 18, which threatened him after the police tip-off.
issues.result_text: Claimant faces the generalized gang risk throughout El Salvador; he is not a person in need of protection.

issues.issue: Whether adequate state protection is available in El Salvador
issues.result_text: Claimant failed to rebut the presumption of state protection with clear and convincing evidence.
